Name: Alternative Evelyn
Author: StaticOpium
Description:
This mod will make old lady more hot. 
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/688-0-1478281472.png[/img]

[u][i]To install:[/i][/u]
1. Go to  "Stardew Valley\Content\" or "\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\" (for steam)
2. Unzip archive "Evely_Portrait.zip"  to the  "\Portrait" folder and overwrite original file.
3. Unzip "Evely_Character.zip" to "\Character" folder.

[size=1]P.S. Don't forget to make backup of the original files. And be careful: all files have the same name.[/size]
